# Prevent expired drafts from returning after recovery settings change

## What & Why
A recovery preference update must not make an already expired answer or opportunity draft available again. This protects users from recovering stale work after the original deadline has passed.

## Done looks like
- An expired answer draft stays unavailable after changing the recovery preference several times.
- An expired opportunity draft stays unavailable after changing the recovery preference several times.
- The existing expiration announcements remain accurate.
